## Antibody Numbering

Number antibody residues with a supported numbering scheme.

Exact job name: `Antibody_Numbering`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`; `experiment_name` is supplied separately.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dataPath` | string | yes | file | Use the exact source field. |
| `scheme` | string | no / mode-dependent | value | values: `Kabat, Chothia, Aho` |
| `property_name` | string | yes | value | `AbNumber` only; preserve the capital N in the backend value. |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
`file_or_value` supports either documented mode; `artifact` is an authorized upstream result reference.
Only local files require a new upload. Never infer input mode from a field name.

```json
      ],

}
```

## Cat_Pred (Catalyst Prediction)

Automatically predicts kcat, Km and Ki for every input row.

Exact job name: `Cat_Pred`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`; `experiment_name` is supplied separately.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `input_path` | string | yes | file | Required CSV storage path returned by boltzmann_upload. The submission credit checker requires exact case-sensitive Seq_id, SMILES and either Sequence or Sequences headers. Lowercase seq_id,sequences,smiles is rejected. Preserve the original file and molecular values; offer a separate reviewed header-corrected copy. CatPred automatically predicts kcat, Km and Ki, with no prediction_type field. These header checks do not establish scientific validity or guarantee service acceptance. |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
`file_or_value` supports either documented mode; `artifact` is an authorized upstream result reference.
Only local files require a new upload. Never infer input mode from a field name.

### Exact request schema

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "input_path": {
      "description": "Required CSV storage path returned by boltzmann_upload. The submission credit checker requires exact case-sensitive Seq_id, SMILES and either Sequence or Sequences headers. Lowercase seq_id,sequences,smiles is rejected. Preserve the original file and molecular values; offer a separate reviewed header-corrected copy. CatPred automatically predicts kcat, Km and Ki, with no prediction_type field. These header checks do not establish scientific validity or guarantee service acceptance.",
      "type": "string",
      "x-input-kind": "file"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "input_path"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

### Submission envelope

```json
  }
}
```

### File checks

```json
  "input_path": {
    "formats": [
      "csv"
    ],

      {
        "columns": [
```

## Catalytic Geometry

Measure or validate evidence-linked reaction-specific geometry.

[Product description and result interpretation](../enzyme-tools-guide.md#catalytic-geometry)

Exact job name: `Catalytic_Geometry`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`; `experiment_name` is supplied separately.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `input_path` | string | yes | file | Uploaded structure or ZIP of structures. |
| `reaction_template` | string | yes | file | Uploaded UTF-8 .json reaction template path; not an inline object through live FastAPI. |
| `template_binding` | string | yes | file | Uploaded UTF-8 .json role-binding path; live FastAPI requires it even though local runtime treats it as optional. |
| `mapping_path` | string / null | no / mode-dependent | file | Optional uploaded JSON candidate mapping. The Node route rejected CSV on 2026-10-22; local worker CSV support is not Node acceptance. |
| `input_source` | string | no / mode-dependent | value | Source adapter; default auto. |
| `execution_mode` | string | no / mode-dependent | value | measurement_only (default) or validation. |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
`file_or_value` supports either documented mode; `artifact` is an authorized upstream result reference.
Only local files require a new upload. Never infer input mode from a field name.

### Exact request schema

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "input_path": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Uploaded structure or ZIP of structures.",
      "x-input-kind": "file"
    },
    "reaction_template": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Uploaded UTF-8 .json reaction template path; not an inline object through live FastAPI.",
      "x-input-kind": "file"

        "string",
        "null"
      ],

      "x-input-kind": "file",
      "pattern": "\\.json$"
    },
    "input_source": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Source adapter; default auto.",
      "x-input-kind": "value",
      "enum": [
        "auto",
        "canonical",
        "rfd3",
        "enzycontrol",
        "frameflow",
        "protein_frame_flow",
        "genzyme",
        "placer",
        "ligandmpnn",
        "solublempnn",
        "zymctrl",
        "mutagenesis",
        "mlde",
        "pepflow",
        "generic"
      ]
    },
    "execution_mode": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "measurement_only (default) or validation.",
      "x-input-kind": "value",
      "enum": [
        "measurement_only",
        "validation"
      ]
    }
  },

    "input_path",
    "reaction_template",

  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

### Execution notices

- Live FastAPI requires template_binding:string; local runtime/docs treat it as optional. Supply a genuine binding file, not a fabricated dummy. Request API fix for binding-free templates.

- Use evidence-based template checks; computational geometry is not catalytic activity evidence.
